text:
Elaine: Heads-up — Enterprise customer ACME wants a dark-launch for their private deployment next month but with tenant-scoped feature flags and local KMS integration. They also asked for a staged region rollout (EU -> US -> APAC) and a strong fallback path to hosted models.
Sam: Sounds doable but we need to lock down requirements. Do they need canary by tenant (percent) or tenant whitelisting? @Miguel can you confirm encryption constraints? :thinking:
Miguel: They require tenant-scoped flags (per-tenant flag namespace) + HSM-backed key wrap. No data leaves their VPC for key material. KMS integration is non-negotiable.
Jordana: From product perspective, priority is: 1) tenant flagging + UI for flagging, 2) staged region scheduling, 3) fallback policy that fails to a compatible open model (not hosted Redwood model). Also need rollout telemetry contract for ACME to sign off.
Carol: We should propose a three-stage rollout plan: dark-launch (0% traffic, shadow), tenant opt-in beta (1-5% of ACME users per region), progressive ramp (10->50->100). Kill-switches at each stage. Keep config as code.
Sam: Agree. Also add automatic fallback rules: if 95th perc latency > 500ms for 3m OR error rate > 1% => route to fallback model variant in same region. If region capacity exhausted, burst to next region following ACME's geo-affinity policy.
Miguel: For private deployment we can't burst to hosted. For Private we offer: fallback to a quantized smaller variant (same infra) or degrade to cached responses. Document both options in the runbook.
Elaine: @deploy-bot can we get a sample feature-flag config proposal for ACME? Need to include tenant namespace, percent, region, canary window, kill-switch id.
deploy-bot: Here is a starter JSON config snippet you can iterate on:
```
{
  "flag_id": "acme.new-llm-routing",
  "tenant": "acme-corp",
  "modes": ["shadow","opt_in","ramp"],
  "regions": [{"name":"eu","percent":0},{"name":"us","percent":1},{"name":"apac","percent":0}],
  "canary_window_minutes": 30,
  "kill_switch_id": "ks-acme-new-routing-v1",
  "fallback_policy": "quantized-variant -> cached-prefix -> error-400"
}
```
Jordana: Nice. We should attach a telemetry spec: required metrics (latency P50/P95/P99, error rate, model quality deltas vs baseline on small eval set), plus automated alerts and a daily digest for ACME.
Carol: Also need sign-off checklist: security review (KMS), perf regression < 5% on P95, no privacy drift. If any fail, roll back to `opt_in` or `off` immediately.
Sam: Action items: Miguel to draft KMS integration doc, Eng-Platform to produce runbook + flag UI mock, Product to draft telemetry contract to send to ACME by EOD Friday.
Elaine: Thanks — I'll sync with ACME CSM and schedule a kickoff. Will post updates here. :rocket:
